task: Parse an AWS CloudWatch log entry and extract the timestamp, log level, and message
solution_criteria: Regex pattern should correctly capture timestamp in ISO 8601 format, log level (INFO, ERROR, WARN, DEBUG), and the remaining message content from a standard CloudWatch log line

task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda function that specifies runtime as Python 3.11, timeout of 60 seconds, memory of 512 MB, and environment variables for DATABASE_URL and API_KEY
solution_criteria: JSON object should have valid syntax, include all specified properties (Runtime, Timeout, MemorySize, Environment.Variables), and follow AWS Lambda configuration structure

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS S3 bucket name and key as parameters and returns True if the object exists, False otherwise, using boto3
solution_criteria: Function should use boto3 S3 client, handle the HeadObject API call appropriately, catch ClientError exception for non-existent objects, and return a boolean value
